	return Config.BiomeById[spec.biome].baseIncome * Config.RarityById[creature.rarity].incomeX
		* (mutation and mutation.incomeX or 1) * (1 + Config.RebirthIncomeStep * (rebirths or 0))
end

function Config.mountSpeed(creature): number

	local mutation = creature.mutation and Config.Mutations[creature.mutation]
	return Config.BiomeById[spec.biome].mountBase + Config.RarityById[creature.rarity].speed
		+ (mutation and mutation.speed or 0) + (spec.ability and 0 or Config.NoAbilitySpeedBonus)
end

-- Exact chance (0..1) of each rarity 1..5 from a normal egg, matching HatchService.roll.
-- luck = roll twice, keep the better; luckyPass = LuckyPassChance of rolls go one rarity up.
-- Shown in the Store before purchase (paid random item odds disclosure).
function Config.hatchOdds(luck: boolean?, luckyPass: boolean?): { number }
	local total, cum, odds = 0, 0, {}
	for i = 1, 5 do
		total += Config.Rarities[i].odds
	end
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local before = cum
		cum += Config.Rarities[i].odds / total
		odds[i] = if luck then cum ^ 2 - before ^ 2 else cum - before
	end
	if luckyPass then
		local p = Config.LuckyPassChance
		for i = 5, 1, -1 do -- descending so odds[i - 1] is still the unshifted value
			odds[i] = odds[i] * (if i == 5 then 1 else 1 - p) + (if i > 1 then odds[i - 1] * p else 0)
		end
	end
	return odds
end

local function part(model: Model, name: string, size: Vector3, color: Color3, cf: CFrame, round: boolean): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.CFrame = cf
	p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	if round then -- Ball parts must be uniform, so ellipsoids are blocks with a sphere mesh
		local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
		mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
		mesh.Parent = p
	end
	p.Parent = model
	return p
end

local function recolor(model: Model, target: Color3, alpha: number, material: Enum.Material?)
	for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and not p.Name:find("^Eye") and p.Transparency < 1 then
			p.Color = p.Color:Lerp(target, alpha)
			if material then
				p.Material = material
			end
		end
	end
end

local function applyMutation(model: Model, body: BasePart, mutation: string?)
	if mutation == "Golden" then
		recolor(model, GOLD, 0.75, Enum.Material.Foil)
		local sparkles = Instance.new("Sparkles")
		sparkles.SparkleColor = GOLD
		sparkles.Parent = body
	elseif mutation == "Cursed" then
		recolor(model, CURSE, 0.6)
		local smoke = Instance.new("Smoke")
		smoke.Color = rgb(40, 0, 0)
		smoke.Opacity = 0.2
		smoke.RiseVelocity = 1.5
		smoke.Size = 1.5
		smoke.Parent = body
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = rgb(255, 40, 40)
		light.Range = 8
		light.Parent = body
	elseif mutation == "Shocked" then
		recolor(model, SHOCK, 0.15)
		local sparks = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		sparks.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(SHOCK)
		sparks.LightEmission = 1
		sparks.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.35, 0)
		sparks.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.4)
		sparks.Rate = 12
		sparks.Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 6)
		sparks.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		sparks.Parent = body
	end
end

local function assemble(name: string, spec, scale: number, mutation: string?): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = name
	local shape = BODY[spec.shape]
	local s = shape.size
	local body = part(model, "Body", s, spec.body, CFrame.new(), shape.round)
	if spec.translucent then
		body.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
		body.Transparency = 0.25
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = body

	local ctx = {
		model = model, spec = spec, bodySize = s, bodyColor = spec.body, accent = spec.accent,
		hw = s.X / 2, top = s.Y / 2, front = -s.Z / 2, back = s.Z / 2,
	}
	if spec.head == false then
		ctx.c, ctx.r = Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0), math.min(s.X, s.Y, s.Z) / 2
	else
		local d = 2.2 * (spec.headSize or 1)
		ctx.c, ctx.r = Vector3.new(0, ctx.top * 0.75 + d * 0.35, ctx.front - d * 0.05), d / 2
		blob(model, "Head", Vector3.new(d, d, d), spec.headColor or spec.body, CFrame.new(ctx.c))
	end
	ctx.k = ctx.r / 1.1

	local hasBigEyes = table.find(spec.features, "bigEyes") ~= nil
	if not hasBigEyes then
		eyes(ctx)
	end

	local legs = spec.legs or 4
	local footColor = spec.footColor or (legs == 2 and spec.accent or darken(spec.body, 0.75))
	if legs == 4 then
		for _, sx in { -1, 1 } do
			for _, sz in { -1, 1 } do
				blob(model, "Foot", Vector3.new(0.9, 0.8, 1.0), footColor, CFrame.new(sx * (ctx.hw - 0.5), -ctx.top - 0.15, sz * (ctx.back - 0.8)))
			end
		end
	elseif legs == 2 then
		for _, sx in { -1, 1 } do
			blob(model, "Foot", Vector3.new(0.8, 0.45, 1.1), footColor, CFrame.new(sx * 0.6, -ctx.top - 0.05, -0.2))
		end
	end

	for _, feature in spec.features do
		local name, style = string.match(feature, "^(%w+):?(%w*)$")
		local fn = F[name]
		assert(fn, name .. ": unknown feature " .. feature)
		fn(ctx, style ~= "" and style or nil)
	end

	if spec.glow then
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = spec.accent
		light.Range = 10
		light.Brightness = 1.2
		light.Parent = body
	end
	applyMutation(model, body, mutation)

	model:ScaleTo(scale)
	for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= body then
			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			weld.Part0 = body
			weld.Part1 = p
			weld.Parent = p
		end
	end
	return model
end

-- Generated meshes (Part 6): ReplicatedStorage.CreatureMeshes/<SpeciesId> and /Guardian_<Biome>.
-- Each template is already scaled to the Common (or guardian) size, faces -Z, and may carry SeatFrac
-- (rider seat height as a fraction of its height). Missing template = the primitive recipe above.
local Meshes = script.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("CreatureMeshes")

local function fromMesh(template: Model, name: string, scale: number, mutation: string?, spec): Model
	local model = template:Clone()
	model.Name = name
	model:ScaleTo(template:GetScale() * scale)
	local body = model.PrimaryPart
	local jointed = {} -- rigged templates (Motor6D legs) keep their joints instead of a weld
	for _, m in model:GetDescendants() do
		if m:IsA("Motor6D") then
			jointed[m.Part1] = true
		end
	end
	for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch = false, false, false
			if p ~= body and not jointed[p] then
				local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
				weld.Part0, weld.Part1 = body, p
				weld.Parent = p
			end
		end
	end
	if spec and spec.glow then
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness = spec.accent, 10, 1.2
		light.Parent = body
	end
	-- textures ignore part Color, so Golden / Cursed also get a tinted Highlight
	-- ponytail: Roblox renders at most 31 Highlights at once; past that the extras just don't show
	if mutation == "Golden" or mutation == "Cursed" then
		local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
		h.FillColor = mutation == "Golden" and GOLD or rgb(150, 0, 20)
		h.FillTransparency = mutation == "Golden" and 0.45 or 0.35
		h.OutlineColor = mutation == "Golden" and rgb(255, 240, 160) or rgb(255, 40, 40)
		h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
		h.Parent = model
	end
	applyMutation(Instance.new("Model"), body, mutation) -- particles / smoke / light only (nothing to recolor)
	local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	model:SetAttribute("SeatHeight", (template:GetAttribute("SeatFrac") or 0.5) * size.Y)
	model:SetAttribute("SeatForward", template:GetAttribute("SeatForward") or 0.3)
	return model
end

function CreatureBuilder.build(speciesId: string, rarityId: string?, mutation: string?): Model
	local spec = Config.Species[speciesId]
	assert(spec, "unknown species " .. tostring(speciesId))
	local rarity = Config.RarityById[rarityId or "Common"]
	assert(rarity, "unknown rarity " .. tostring(rarityId))
	local mesh = Meshes and Meshes:FindFirstChild(speciesId)
	local model = mesh and fromMesh(mesh, speciesId, rarity.scale, mutation, spec)
		or assemble(speciesId, spec, (spec.size or 1) * rarity.scale, mutation)
	model:SetAttribute("RestHeight", model:GetExtentsSize().Y)
	model:SetAttribute("CanFly", spec.canFly == true)
	model:SetAttribute("Gait", spec.locomotion or (spec.legs == 0 and "float" or spec.legs == 2 and "biped" or "quad"))
	model:SetAttribute("Species", speciesId)
	model:SetAttribute("Rarity", rarity.id)
	model:SetAttribute("Mutation", mutation)
	return model
end

function CreatureBuilder.buildGuardian(biomeId: string, scale: number?): Model
	local g = Config.Guardians[biomeId]
	assert(g, "no guardian for " .. tostring(biomeId))
	local mesh = Meshes and Meshes:FindFirstChild("Guardian_" .. biomeId)
	if mesh then
		return fromMesh(mesh, Config.BiomeById[biomeId].guardian, (scale or g.scale) / g.scale, nil, g.recipe)
	end
	return assemble(Config.BiomeById[biomeId].guardian, g.recipe, scale or g.scale, nil)
end

-- Regular eggs hint at their assigned species; Secret Eggs keep their original appearance.
function CreatureBuilder.buildEgg(biomeId: string, mutation: string?, secret: boolean?, speciesId: string?): Model
	local spec = not secret and speciesId and Config.Species[speciesId]
	if spec and spec.biome ~= biomeId then spec = nil end
	local accent = spec and spec.accent or Config.BiomeById[biomeId].look.accent
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = biomeId .. "Egg"
	local shell = blob(model, "Shell", Vector3.new(2, 2.6, 2), (spec and spec.body or accent):Lerp(WHITE, spec and 0.15 or 0.45), CFrame.new())
	model.PrimaryPart = shell
	for i, off in { Vector3.new(0.6, 0.5, -0.75), Vector3.new(-0.7, -0.2, -0.55), Vector3.new(0.2, -0.7, 0.85), Vector3.new(-0.5, 0.7, 0.7) } do
		blob(model, "Spot" .. i, Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.25), darken(accent, 0.8), CFrame.lookAt(off, off * 2))
	end
	if spec then
		local clues = { ears = true, wings = true, horns = true, spikes = true, shell = true, tentacles = true }
		local ctx = { model = model, spec = spec, bodyColor = spec.body, accent = spec.accent,
			c = Vector3.new(), r = 0.7, k = 0.5, hw = 1, back = 1, front = -1, top = 1.3, bodySize = shell.Size }
		for _, feature in spec.features do
			local name, style = string.match(feature, "^(%w+):?(%w*)$")
			if clues[name] then
				F[name](ctx, style ~= "" and style or nil)
				break -- one silhouette clue; palette and shell spots supply the rest
			end
		end
	end
	if secret then
		shell.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		shell.Color = rgb(255, 120, 220)
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = rgb(255, 150, 230)
		light.Range = 14
		light.Brightness = 2
		light.Parent = shell
	end
	applyMutation(model, shell, mutation)
	for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= shell then
			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			weld.Part0 = shell
			weld.Part1 = p
			weld.Parent = p
		end
	end
	model:SetAttribute("Biome", biomeId)
	return model
end

-- Puts the model's lowest point on groundCFrame, facing groundCFrame's -Z.
function CreatureBuilder.placeOn(model: Model, groundCFrame: CFrame)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	local boxCFrame, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local lift = -(boxCFrame.Position.Y - size.Y / 2)
	model:PivotTo(groundCFrame * CFrame.new(0, lift, 0))
end

return CreatureBuilder

-- Nest eggs, grabbing, carrying (egg welded above the head), and dropping off at your plot's incubators.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local CreatureBuilder = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CreatureBuilder)
local PlotService = require(script.Parent.PlotService)
local HatchService = require(script.Parent.HatchService)

local Notify = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Notify

local EggService = {}
EggService.onGrab = nil -- function(player, biomeId), set by Main (wakes the guardian)
EggService.onOrphanDrop = nil -- function(player, egg) for eggs with no nest spot (secret / raided), set by Main
EggService.rollMutation = function(_biomeId) -- replaced by EventService during weather
	return nil
end

local carried = {} -- [player] = { biome, mutation, secret, spot, model, diedConn }
local nests = {} -- [biomeId] = { [spotPart] = eggModel | false }
local lastFullWarning = {}

local function anchorAll(model, anchored)
	for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Anchored = anchored
			p.CanCollide = false
			p.Massless = true
		end
	end
end

local function updateStock(biomeId)
	local nest = workspace.Biomes[biomeId]:FindFirstChild("Nest")
	local stock = 0
	for _, model in nests[biomeId] do
		if model then stock += 1 end
	end
	nest:SetAttribute("EggStock", stock)
end

local function spawnNestEgg(biomeId: string, spot: BasePart, returnedEgg)
	local egg = returnedEgg or { biome = biomeId }
	HatchService.assignSpecies(egg)
	local model = CreatureBuilder.buildEgg(biomeId, nil, false, egg.species)
	model:SetAttribute("EggSpecies", egg.species)
	anchorAll(model, true)
	model:PivotTo(spot.CFrame)
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Steal Egg"
	prompt.ObjectText = biomeId .. " Egg"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0 -- tap to grab
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		EggService.grab(player, biomeId, spot)
	end)
	model.Parent = spot.Parent.Parent -- the Nest model
	nests[biomeId][spot] = model
	updateStock(biomeId)
end

function EggService.isCarrying(player): boolean
	return carried[player] ~= nil
end

function EggService.getCarried(player)
	return carried[player]
end

-- Weld an egg above the player's head and mark them as a carrier
function EggService.attach(player, egg)
	local character = player.Character
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not head or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or carried[player] then
		return false
	end
	local model = CreatureBuilder.buildEgg(egg.biome, egg.mutation, egg.secret, egg.species)
	anchorAll(model, false)
	model:PivotTo(head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.6, 0))
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = head
	weld.Part1 = model.PrimaryPart
	weld.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	model.Name = "CarriedEgg"
	model.Parent = character
	egg.model = model
	egg.diedConn = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		EggService.drop(player)
	end)
	carried[player] = egg
	player:SetAttribute("CarryingEgg", egg.biome)
	return true
end

-- Remove the carried egg and return it (without sending it anywhere)
function EggService.take(player)
	local egg = carried[player]
	if not egg then
		return nil
	end
	carried[player] = nil
	if egg.diedConn then
		egg.diedConn:Disconnect()
	end
	if egg.model then
		egg.model:Destroy()
	end
	egg.model, egg.diedConn = nil, nil
	player:SetAttribute("CarryingEgg", nil)
	return egg
end

-- Carrier caught, died or left: the egg goes back to its nest spot (or to whoever owns it)
function EggService.drop(player)
	local egg = EggService.take(player)
	if not egg then
		return nil
	end
	if egg.spot then
		if nests[egg.biome] and not nests[egg.biome][egg.spot] then
			spawnNestEgg(egg.biome, egg.spot, egg)
		end
	elseif EggService.onOrphanDrop then
		EggService.onOrphanDrop(player, egg)
	end
	return egg
end

function EggService.carriers()
	return carried
end

-- An egg lying on the ground with its own prompt (Secret Eggs, eggs knocked out of Mama's hoard). Returns the model.
function EggService.spawnLoose(egg, cframe: CFrame, actionText: string)
	local model = CreatureBuilder.buildEgg(egg.biome, egg.mutation, egg.secret, egg.species)
	anchorAll(model, true)
	model:ScaleTo(1.4)
	model:PivotTo(cframe)
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = actionText
	prompt.ObjectText = egg.secret and "Secret Egg" or egg.biome .. " Egg"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.5
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not model.Parent or carried[player] or not root or (root.Position - cframe.Position).Magnitude > 16 then
			return
		end
		if EggService.attach(player, egg) then
			model:Destroy()
			if EggService.onGrab and not egg.fromMama then -- Mama's eggs lie on Home Row: no guardian to wake
				EggService.onGrab(player, egg.biome)
			end
		end
	end)
	model.Parent = workspace
	return model
end

function EggService.grab(player, biomeId: string, spot: BasePart)
	local model = nests[biomeId] and nests[biomeId][spot]
	if not model or carried[player] then
		return
	end
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or (root.Position - spot.Position).Magnitude > 14 then
		return
	end
	local egg = { biome = biomeId, species = model:GetAttribute("EggSpecies"),
		mutation = EggService.rollMutation(biomeId), secret = false, spot = spot }
	nests[biomeId][spot] = false
	updateStock(biomeId)
	model:Destroy()
	if not EggService.attach(player, egg) then
		spawnNestEgg(biomeId, spot, egg)
		return
	end
	if EggService.onGrab then
		EggService.onGrab(player, biomeId)
	end
end

local function insidePlot(plot, pos: Vector3): boolean
	local floor = plot.Floor
	local offset = pos - floor.Position
	return math.abs(offset.X) < floor.Size.X / 2 and math.abs(offset.Z) < floor.Size.Z / 2
end

local function refill(biomeId: string, maxEggs: number): number
	local added = 0
	for spot, egg in nests[biomeId] do
		if not egg and added < maxEggs then
			spawnNestEgg(biomeId, spot)
			added += 1
		end
	end
	return added
end

function EggService.registerNest(biomeId: string)
	local nest = workspace.Biomes[biomeId]:FindFirstChild("Nest")
	if not nest or nests[biomeId] then
		return
	end
	nests[biomeId] = {}
	local spots = nest.EggSpots:GetChildren()
	table.sort(spots, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
	local capacity = biomeId == "Forest" and Config.Nests.forestEggs or Config.Nests.eggs
	for i, spot in spots do
		if i <= capacity then nests[biomeId][spot] = false end
	end
	nest:SetAttribute("EggCapacity", math.min(capacity, #spots))
	nest:SetAttribute("NextRefill", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + (biomeId == "Forest" and Config.Nests.forestRefill or Config.Nests.refillInterval))
	refill(biomeId, math.huge)
end

function EggService.start()
	for _, biome in Config.Biomes do
		EggService.registerNest(biome.id)
	end

	-- drop-off check: carriers standing on their own plot
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.2)
			for player, egg in carried do
				local plot = PlotService.get(player)
				local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if plot and root and insidePlot(plot, root.Position) then
					if HatchService.deposit(player, egg) then
						EggService.take(player)
						Notify:FireClient(player, "toast", "Egg in the incubator!")
					elseif os.clock() - (lastFullWarning[player] or 0) > 4 then
						lastFullWarning[player] = os.clock()
						Notify:FireClient(player, "toast", "Incubators full!")
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	-- anti speed-hack: a carrier moving faster than the server allows drops the egg
	local lastPos = {}
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.5)
			for player in carried do
				local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if root then
					local pos = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, 0, root.Position.Z)
					local prev = lastPos[player]
					if prev and EggService.allowedSpeed then
						local speed = (pos - prev.pos).Magnitude / (os.clock() - prev.t)
						if speed > EggService.allowedSpeed(player) * 1.4 + 5 then
							EggService.drop(player)
							Notify:FireClient(player, "toast", "You dropped the egg: moving too fast!")
						end
					end
					lastPos[player] = { pos = pos, t = os.clock() }
				end
			end
			for player in lastPos do
				if not carried[player] then
					lastPos[player] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Forest trickles back one egg at a time so new players never get stuck
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.Nests.forestRefill)
			refill("Forest", 1)
			workspace.Biomes.Forest.Nest:SetAttribute("NextRefill", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + Config.Nests.forestRefill)
		end
	end)
	-- every other nest refills together
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.Nests.refillInterval)
			local added = 0
			for biomeId in nests do
				if biomeId ~= "Forest" then
					added += refill(biomeId, math.huge)
					workspace.Biomes[biomeId].Nest:SetAttribute("NextRefill", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + Config.Nests.refillInterval)
				end
			end
			if added > 0 then
				Notify:FireAllClients("toast", "Nests refilled!")
			end
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		EggService.drop(player)
		lastFullWarning[player] = nil
	end)
end

return EggService

-- Guardians: patrol a circle around the nest, turn on a grabber almost instantly (Config.Guardian.wakeDelay), chase in a straight line,
-- catch + fling, then walk back to the circle.
-- A guardian hunts whoever grabs its egg all the way home (other biomes' carriers only get caught if they bump
-- into it): the chase only ends in the safe zone (past the Forest exit line), in a usable escape patch, or on a catch.
-- Anchored models moved with PivotTo on Heartbeat (no Humanoids). Walking guardians path around solid props and
-- patches like players have to; flyers go straight over. See chaseTarget for the anti-juke rules.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local CreatureBuilder = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CreatureBuilder)
local WalkCycle = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.WalkCycle)
local SpeedService = require(script.Parent.SpeedService)

local Notify = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Notify

local GuardianService = {}
GuardianService.speedMultiplier = 1 -- Blood Moon raises this
GuardianService.canEscape = function(_player, _biomeId) -- escape lanes hook (Part 3)
	return false
end
GuardianService.hasLane = function(_player, _biomeId) -- rides the biome's lane ability? set by Main
	return true
end

local guardians = {} -- [biomeId] = { model, home, radius, state, wakeAt, biome, prey, slowUntil, slowFactor, ... }
GuardianService.caughtAt = {} -- [player] = os.clock() of their last catch (no stealing right after)
local eggService

local function flat(v: Vector3): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end

local zones = {} -- { id, entranceZ, farZ } per biome
local safeZ -- the Forest exit line: anyone past it (toward home) is safe

local function biomeAt(z: number): string?
	for _, zone in zones do
		if z <= zone.entranceZ and z >= zone.farZ then
			return zone.id
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- a carrier who can still be chased: has an egg, isn't home yet, isn't in an escape lane they can use
local function huntable(player)
	local root = player.Parent and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not player:GetAttribute("CarryingEgg") or root.Position.Z > safeZ then
		return nil, nil
	end
	local biomeId = biomeAt(root.Position.Z)
	if biomeId and GuardianService.canEscape(player, biomeId) then
		return nil, nil
	end
	return root, biomeId
end

function GuardianService.wake(player, biomeId: string)
	local g = guardians[biomeId]
	if not g then
		return
	end
	local newPrey = player and not g.prey[player]
	if player then
		g.prey[player] = true
	end
	if g.state == "patrol" or g.state == "return" then
		g.state = "waking"
		local noLane = player and not GuardianService.hasLane(player, biomeId)
		g.wakeAt = os.clock() + (noLane and Config.Guardian.noLaneWakeDelay or Config.Guardian.wakeDelay)
	end
	if newPrey then -- roar + chase sting on the hunted player's client
		if not GuardianService.hasLane(player, biomeId) then
			Notify:FireClient(player, "toast", ("No %s ride: the %s reacts instantly and the escape patches won't hide you!"):format(g.biome.lane, g.biome.guardian))
		end
		task.delay(math.max(0, (g.wakeAt or 0) - os.clock()), function()
			if player.Parent and g.prey[player] then
				Notify:FireClient(player, "chase", biomeId)
			end
		end)
	end
end

-- nearest hunted player who is still huntable (drops the rest from the list)
local function findTarget(g)
	local best, bestDist
	for player in g.prey do
		local root = huntable(player)
		if not root then
			g.prey[player] = nil
		else
			local d = g.canFly and (root.Position - g.cf.Position).Magnitude or (flat(root.Position) - flat(g.cf.Position)).Magnitude
			if not bestDist or d < bestDist then
				best, bestDist = player, d
			end
		end
	end
	if g.model:GetAttribute("ChaseTarget") ~= (best and best.UserId) then
		g.model:SetAttribute("ChaseTarget", best and best.UserId)
	end
	return best, bestDist
end

local function goHome(g)
	g.model:SetAttribute("ChaseTarget", nil)
	g.state = "return"
	table.clear(g.prey) -- carriers still in its biome get picked up again by the pass-through check
end

local function patrolPoint(g): Vector3
	return g.center + Vector3.new(math.cos(g.angle) * g.patrolR, 0, math.sin(g.angle) * g.patrolR)
end

local function moveToward(g, target: Vector3, dt: number, mult: number?): number
	local pos = g.cf.Position -- the real position; the model shows it plus the walk bounce
	local altitude = g.canFly and g.state == "chase" and math.max(g.home.Position.Y, target.Y) or g.home.Position.Y
	local goal = Vector3.new(target.X, altitude, target.Z)
	local delta = goal - pos
	local dist = delta.Magnitude
	if dist < 0.05 then
		return 0
	end
	local speed = g.biome.guardianSpeed * GuardianService.speedMultiplier * (mult or 1)
	if g.state == "chase" then -- winds up from patrol pace to full speed
		local G = Config.Guardian
		local chasing = os.clock() - g.chaseStart
		speed *= math.min(1, G.patrolSpeedMult + (1 - G.patrolSpeedMult) * chasing / G.chaseRamp)
		if chasing > G.tireAfter then
			speed *= G.tiredMult
		end
		if g.noLane then
			speed *= G.noLaneSpeedMult
		end
	end
	if (g.slowUntil or 0) > os.clock() then
		speed *= g.slowFactor
	end
	local step = math.min(dist, speed * dt)
	local newPos = pos + delta.Unit * step
	g.cf = CFrame.lookAt(newPos, newPos + delta.Unit)
	g.moved += step
	return dist - step
end

-- solid props and patches: what walking guardians must go around (filled in start)
local blockers = RaycastParams.new()
blockers.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
blockers.RespectCanCollide = true

local function clearLine(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): boolean
	local a, b = Vector3.new(from.X, 3, from.Z), Vector3.new(to.X, 3, to.Z)
	return workspace:Raycast(a, b - a, blockers) == nil
end

local function repath(g, goal: Vector3)
	g.computing = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local G = Config.Guardian
		local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({ AgentRadius = G.pathRadius, AgentHeight = 8, AgentCanJump = false, WaypointSpacing = 6 })
		local ok = pcall(function()
			path:ComputeAsync(Vector3.new(g.cf.Position.X, 3, g.cf.Position.Z), goal)
		end)
		g.waypoints = ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success and path:GetWaypoints() or nil
		g.wp, g.pathAt, g.computing = 2, os.clock(), false
	end)
end

-- Where a chasing guardian heads this frame, and a speed multiplier. Obstacles cost you distance, never the chase:
-- it always knows where you are, cuts straight in when close and clear, pushes through if it stops making progress,
-- speeds up a little when far behind and out of sight, and lunges when close.
local function chaseTarget(g, goal: Vector3, dist: number, now: number): (Vector3, number)
	local G = Config.Guardian
	if g.canFly then
		return goal, 1
	end
	local pos = g.cf.Position
	local see = clearLine(pos, goal)
	if see and dist <= G.lungeRange + g.radius and now >= (g.lungeReadyAt or 0) then
		g.lungeUntil, g.lungeReadyAt = now + G.lungeSeconds, now + G.lungeCooldown
	end
	if (g.lungeUntil or 0) > now then
		return goal, G.lungeMult
	end
	local mult = (dist > G.catchUpRange + g.radius and not see) and G.catchUpMult or 1
	if now - (g.windowAt or 0) >= G.stuckSeconds then
		if g.windowPos and (flat(pos) - flat(g.windowPos)).Magnitude < g.biome.guardianSpeed * G.stuckSeconds * 0.3 then
			g.pushUntil = now + G.stuckSeconds * 1.5
		end
		g.windowPos, g.windowAt = pos, now
	end
	if (see and dist <= G.directRange + g.radius) or (g.pushUntil or 0) > now then
		return goal, mult
	end
	if not g.computing and now - (g.pathAt or 0) >= G.pathEvery then
		repath(g, goal)
	end
	local wps = g.waypoints
	if not wps then
		return goal, mult -- no route found: straight at you
	end
	while wps[g.wp] and (flat(wps[g.wp].Position) - flat(pos)).Magnitude < 4 do
		g.wp += 1
	end
	return wps[g.wp] and wps[g.wp].Position or goal, mult
end

local function catch(g, player)
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	eggService.drop(player)
	GuardianService.caughtAt[player] = os.clock()
	if root then
		local away = flat(root.Position - g.cf.Position)
		away = away.Magnitude > 0.01 and away.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
		Notify:FireClient(player, "fling", away * 70 + Vector3.new(0, 55, 0))
	end
	SpeedService.stun(player, Config.Guardian.stun)
	Notify:FireClient(player, "toast", ("Caught by the %s!"):format(g.biome.guardian))
	goHome(g)
end

-- the cartoon walk: steps follow distance travelled; each footfall sets the Step attribute (clients puff dust)
local function animate(g, now: number, dt: number)
	local moving = g.moved > 0
	g.amount = math.clamp(g.amount + (moving and dt or -dt) * 5, 0, 1)
	if moving then
		local before = math.floor(g.phase)
		g.phase += g.moved / g.stride
		if math.floor(g.phase) ~= before and not (g.canFly and g.cf.Position.Y > g.home.Position.Y + .5) then
			g.model:SetAttribute("Step", math.floor(g.phase))
		end
	end
	g.moved = 0
	local airborne = g.canFly and g.cf.Position.Y > g.home.Position.Y + .5
	local pose = airborne and WalkCycle.offset(now * 1.5, 1, g.height, "fly")
		or g.amount > 0 and WalkCycle.offset(g.phase, g.amount, g.height, g.gait) or WalkCycle.idle(now, g.height)
	g.model:SetAttribute("Airborne", airborne == true)
	g.model:PivotTo(g.cf * pose)
	WalkCycle.animateJoints(g.joints, g.phase, g.amount, now, g.gait, airborne == true)
end

local function step(dt: number)
	local now = os.clock()
	-- pass-through: a guardian hunts carriers of its own eggs anywhere in its biome; carriers of other biomes' eggs
	-- it ignores, but bump into it and you're caught (it's a moving obstacle to weave past on the way home)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local root, biomeId = huntable(player)
		local g = root and biomeId and guardians[biomeId]
		if g and not g.prey[player] then
			if player:GetAttribute("CarryingEgg") == biomeId then
				GuardianService.wake(player, biomeId)
			elseif (flat(root.Position) - flat(g.cf.Position)).Magnitude <= Config.Guardian.catchRadius + g.radius then
				catch(g, player)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, g in guardians do
		if g.state == "waking" and now >= g.wakeAt then
			g.state, g.chaseStart = "chase", now
			g.waypoints, g.pathAt, g.windowPos, g.windowAt, g.pushUntil = nil, 0, nil, now, 0
		end
		if g.state == "chase" then
			local player, dist = findTarget(g)
			if not player then
				goHome(g)
			elseif dist <= Config.Guardian.catchRadius + g.radius
				and (g.canFly or math.abs(player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position.Y - g.cf.Position.Y) <= g.height * .5 + Config.Guardian.catchRadius) then
				catch(g, player)
			else
				g.noLane = not GuardianService.hasLane(player, g.biome.id)
				local target, mult = chaseTarget(g, player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position, dist, now)
				moveToward(g, target, dt, mult)
			end
		elseif g.state == "return" then
			if moveToward(g, patrolPoint(g), dt) <= 1 then
				g.state = "patrol"
			end
		elseif g.state == "patrol" then
			local speed = g.biome.guardianSpeed * Config.Guardian.patrolSpeedMult
			g.angle += speed * dt / g.patrolR
			moveToward(g, patrolPoint(g), dt, Config.Guardian.patrolSpeedMult * 1.5) -- a bit of slack so it never lags the point
		end
		animate(g, now, dt)
	end
end

function GuardianService.spawn(biomeId: string)

	local model = CreatureBuilder.buildGuardian(biomeId)
	local rigged = model:GetAttribute("Rigged")
	for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Anchored = not rigged or p == model.PrimaryPart -- rigged: legs hang off the anchored body by their joints
		end
	end
local joints = WalkCycle.bind(model)
	CreatureBuilder.placeOn(model, spot.CFrame)
	model.Name = "Guardian"
	model.Parent = biomeModel
	local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local nest = biomeModel:FindFirstChild("Nest")
	local home = model:GetPivot().Position
	local center = nest and Vector3.new(nest:GetPivot().Position.X, home.Y, nest:GetPivot().Position.Z) or home
	guardians[biomeId] = {
		center = center, angle = math.atan2(home.Z - center.Z, home.X - center.X),
		-- radius: body length, not wingspan. Mesh guardians carry the primitive's (BodyRadius) so catch distances stay as tested
		model = model, home = model:GetPivot(), radius = model:GetAttribute("BodyRadius") or size.Z / 2, state = "patrol",
		biome = Config.BiomeById[biomeId], prey = {},
		cf = model:GetPivot(), moved = 0, phase = 0, amount = 0, height = size.Y, stride = WalkCycle.stride(model),
		gait = Config.Guardians[biomeId].gait, joints = joints, canFly = Config.Guardians[biomeId].canFly == true,
	}
	local g = guardians[biomeId] -- patrol just outside its own catch reach, so grabbing behind its back is fair
	g.patrolR = Config.Guardian.catchRadius + g.radius + Config.Guardian.patrolGap
end

-- Incubators: normal eggs keep their chosen species; rarity rolls when the timer finishes.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local CreatureBuilder = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CreatureBuilder)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local PlotService = require(script.Parent.PlotService)
local CreatureService = require(script.Parent.CreatureService)

local Notify = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Notify
local rng = Random.new()

local HatchService = {}
HatchService.onRaid = nil -- function(thief, owner, slot), set by Main (StealService)

local function hatchTime(egg): number
	if egg.lucky then
		return Config.Events.luckyHatch
	elseif egg.secret then
		return Config.Events.secretHatch
	end
	return Config.BiomeById[egg.biome].hatchTime
end

local function weighted(weights): number
	local total = 0
	for _, w in weights do
		total += w
	end
	local r = rng:NextNumber() * total
	for i, w in weights do
		r -= w
		if r <= 0 then
			return i
		end
	end
	return #weights
end

local RARITY_ODDS = {}
for i = 1, 5 do
	RARITY_ODDS[i] = Config.Rarities[i].odds
end

-- Assign only regular eggs; special rewards and old-save fallback keep their original rules.
function HatchService.assignSpecies(egg): string?
	if egg.secret or egg.lucky then return nil end
	local biome = Config.BiomeById[egg.biome]
	if not biome then return nil end
	if type(egg.species) ~= "string" or not table.find(biome.species, egg.species) then
		egg.species = biome.species[weighted(Config.SpeciesWeights)]
	end
	return egg.species
end

-- Pure rarity roll with a persistent regular-egg species: returns { species, rarity, mutation }
-- luck (Luck Potion / Server Luck): roll rarity twice, keep the better. luckyPass: 10% of rolls go one step up.
function HatchService.roll(egg, luck: boolean?, luckyPass: boolean?)
	local biome = Config.BiomeById[egg.biome]
	local species = HatchService.assignSpecies(egg) or biome.species[weighted(Config.SpeciesWeights)]
	local rarityIndex
	if egg.secret then
		rarityIndex = weighted(Config.Events.secretOdds) -- Epic or better, sometimes Mythic
	else
		rarityIndex = weighted(RARITY_ODDS)
		if luck then
			rarityIndex = math.max(rarityIndex, weighted(RARITY_ODDS))
		end
		if luckyPass and rng:NextNumber() < Config.LuckyPassChance then
			rarityIndex = math.min(rarityIndex + 1, 5)
		end
		if egg.lucky then
			rarityIndex = math.clamp(rarityIndex + 1, 2, 5)
		end
	end
	return { species = species, rarity = Config.Rarities[rarityIndex].id, mutation = egg.mutation }
end

local function eggFolder(plot)
	local folder = plot:FindFirstChild("IncubatorEggs")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "IncubatorEggs"
		folder.Parent = plot
	end
	return folder
end

local function render(player)
	local plot = PlotService.get(player)
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	if not plot or not data then
		return
	end
	local folder = eggFolder(plot)
	folder:ClearAllChildren()
	local incubating = 0
	for _, pad in plot.Incubators:GetChildren() do
		local slot = pad:GetAttribute("Slot")
		local egg = data.Incubators[slot]
		pad.Transparency = slot <= data.IncubatorCount and 0 or 0.7
		pad.Ring.Transparency = slot <= data.IncubatorCount and 0 or 0.8
		if egg then
			incubating += 1
			local model = CreatureBuilder.buildEgg(egg.biome, egg.mutation, egg.secret, egg.species)
			for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") then
					p.Anchored = true
				end
			end
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pad.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)))
			model.Name = "Egg" .. slot
			local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
			prompt.Name = "RaidPrompt"
			prompt.ActionText = "Steal Egg"
			prompt.ObjectText = player.DisplayName .. "'s egg"
			prompt.HoldDuration = Config.Steal.baseHold
			prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 8
			prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
			prompt:SetAttribute("Owner", player.UserId) -- the owner's client hides its own prompts
			prompt.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(thief)
				if HatchService.onRaid then
					HatchService.onRaid(thief, player, slot)
				end
			end)
			model.Parent = folder
		else
			pad.Timer.Text.Text = slot <= data.IncubatorCount and "Empty" or "Locked"
		end
	end
	player:SetAttribute("Incubating", incubating)
end

local function freeSlot(data): number?
	for slot = 1, data.IncubatorCount do
		if not data.Incubators[slot] then
			return slot
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Puts an egg { biome, mutation?, secret?, lucky? } into a free incubator. false if all are full.
function HatchService.deposit(player, egg, progress: number?): boolean
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	local slot = data and freeSlot(data)
	if not slot then
		return false
	end
	HatchService.assignSpecies(egg)
	data.Incubators[slot] = { biome = egg.biome, species = egg.species, mutation = egg.mutation, secret = egg.secret, lucky = egg.lucky,
		startedAt = os.time() - (progress or 0) }
	render(player)
	return true
end

-- Take an egg out of an incubator (raids). Hatch progress is lost.
function HatchService.takeEgg(player, slot: number)
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	local egg = data and data.Incubators[slot]
	if not egg then
		return nil
	end
	data.Incubators[slot] = false
	render(player)
	return { biome = egg.biome, species = egg.species, mutation = egg.mutation, secret = egg.secret, lucky = egg.lucky }, os.time() - egg.startedAt
end

-- slots that still have an egg (Mama's Revenge picks from these)
function HatchService.filledSlots(player)
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	local slots = {}
	for slot = 1, data and data.IncubatorCount or 0 do
		if data.Incubators[slot] then
			table.insert(slots, slot)
		end
	end
	return slots
end

-- Instant Hatch (developer product): every egg finishes on the next tick
function HatchService.instantHatch(player)
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	for slot = 1, data and data.IncubatorCount or 0 do
		local egg = data.Incubators[slot]
		if egg then
			egg.startedAt = 0
		end
	end
end

-- eggs that will be ready the moment the player is back (offline summary)
function HatchService.readyCount(player): number
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	local n = 0
	for slot = 1, data and data.IncubatorCount or 0 do
		local egg = data.Incubators[slot]
		if egg and os.time() - egg.startedAt >= hatchTime(egg) then
			n += 1
		end
	end
	return n
end

-- Queue an egg for when an incubator frees up (Mama's Revenge returns, Lucky Eggs)
function HatchService.give(player, egg, progress: number?)
	if not HatchService.deposit(player, egg, progress) then
		local data = DataService.get(player)
		HatchService.assignSpecies(egg)
		table.insert(data.PendingEggs, { biome = egg.biome, species = egg.species, mutation = egg.mutation, secret = egg.secret, lucky = egg.lucky, progress = progress or 0 })
	end
end

local function tick(player)
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	local plot = PlotService.get(player)
	if not data or not plot then
		return
	end
	local now, dirty = os.time(), false
	for slot = 1, data.IncubatorCount do
		local egg = data.Incubators[slot]
		if egg then
			local left = hatchTime(egg) - (now - egg.startedAt)
			local label = plot.Incubators["Incubator" .. slot].Timer.Text
			if left > 0 then
				label.Text = ("%d:%02d"):format(left // 60, left % 60)
			else
				local paidOk = player:GetAttribute("PaidLuckBlocked") == false -- set by MonetizationService from PolicyService
				local luck = (data.LuckUntil or 0) > now
					or paidOk and ((data.PaidLuckUntil or 0) > now or (workspace:GetAttribute("ServerLuckUntil") or 0) > now)
				egg.result = egg.result or HatchService.roll(egg, luck, paidOk and player:GetAttribute("LuckyPass")) -- roll once, even if it waits for room
				if CreatureService.add(player, egg.result) then
					Notify:FireClient(player, "hatched", egg.result, slot)
					if Config.RarityById[egg.result.rarity].index >= 5 then
						Notify:FireAllClients("toast", ('%s hatched a <font color="#%s">%s %s</font>!'):format(player.DisplayName,
							Config.RarityById[egg.result.rarity].color:ToHex(), egg.result.rarity, Config.Species[egg.result.species].display))
					end
					data.Incubators[slot] = false
					dirty = true
				else
					label.Text = '<font color="#ff6b6b">Pen & stable full!</font>'
				end
			end
		end
	end
	while #data.PendingEggs > 0 and freeSlot(data) do
		local egg = table.remove(data.PendingEggs, 1)
		HatchService.deposit(player, egg, egg.progress)
		dirty = true
	end
	if dirty then
		render(player)
	end
end

function HatchService.onPlayerReady(player)
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	for slot = 1, data.IncubatorCount do -- older saves / new incubators
		if data.Incubators[slot] == nil then
			data.Incubators[slot] = false
		end
	end
	render(player)
end

function HatchService.cleanup(player)
	local plot = PlotService.get(player)
	if plot then
		eggFolder(plot):ClearAllChildren()
		for _, pad in plot.Incubators:GetChildren() do
			pad.Timer.Text.Text = ""
			pad.Transparency = 0
			pad.Ring.Transparency = 0
		end
	end
end

function HatchService.start()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				task.spawn(tick, player)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return HatchService

local function topList(fight)

-- a hoard egg falls on the ground near her; anyone can grab it and carry it home
local function knockLoose(fight)

		item.shown:Destroy()
	end
	setAttr("MamaHoard", #fight.hoard)

	local egg = { biome = item.egg.biome, species = item.egg.species, mutation = item.egg.mutation, secret = item.egg.secret, lucky = item.egg.lucky,
		owner = item.owner, fromMama = true }
	table.insert(fight.loose, { model = EggService.spawnLoose(egg, CFrame.new(spot), "Grab Egg"), egg = egg, progress = item.progress })

local function afterDamage(fight)
	setAttr("MamaHP", math.max(0, fight.hp))
	while fight.maxHp - fight.hp >= fight.nextDrop do
		fight.nextDrop += fight.maxHp * E.mamaDropEvery
		if #fight.hoard > 0 and fight.hp > 0 then
			knockLoose(fight)
		end
	end
	if fight.hp <= 0 then
		fight.over = "defeated"
	end

-- red ring under her, then the slam: grounded players inside get knocked back and stunned
local function bigStomp(fight)
	local pos = fight.model:GetPivot().Position
	local center = Vector3.new(pos.X, START.Y + 0.05, pos.Z)
	local ring = Instance.new("Part")
	ring.Name = "MamaStompRing"
	ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	ring.Anchored, ring.CanCollide, ring.CanQuery, ring.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
	ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
	ring.Transparency = 0.55
	ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, E.mamaStompRadius * 2, E.mamaStompRadius * 2)
	ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(center) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	ring.Parent = workspace
	task.wait(E.mamaStompWarn)
	ring:Destroy()
	if fight.over then
		return
	end
	Notify:FireAllClients("stomp", center)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local state = humanoid and humanoid:GetState()
		local airborne = state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
		local away = root and Vector3.new(root.Position.X - center.X, 0, root.Position.Z - center.Z)
		if away and away.Magnitude <= E.mamaStompRadius and not airborne then
			away = away.Magnitude > 0.1 and away.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
			Notify:FireClient(player, "fling", away * 60 + Vector3.new(0, 35, 0))
			SpeedService.stun(player, E.mamaStompStun)
			Notify:FireClient(player, "toast", "Stomped! Jump or get out of the red ring!")
		end
	end
end

local function onHit(fight, player, orb, origin, direction)
	if fight.over or not player.Parent or not player.Character or orb ~= fight.activeOrb then
		return false
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0
		or not ((root.Position - orb.Position).Magnitude <= E.mamaClickRange) then
		return false
	end
	if origin ~= nil or direction ~= nil then
		if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3"
			or not ((origin - root.Position).Magnitude <= math.min(256, (player.CameraMaxZoomDistance or 128) + 4))
			or not (direction.Magnitude >= 0.99 and direction.Magnitude <= 1.01) then
			return false
		end
	else
		local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
		origin = head.Position
		local delta = orb.Position - origin
		if delta.Magnitude == 0 then return false end
		direction = delta.Unit
	end
	-- One shared rolling attempt budget keeps click + hold capped and bounds server raycasts.

	local now = os.clock()
	local clicks = fight.clicks[player] or {}
	fight.clicks[player] = clicks
	while clicks[1] and now - clicks[1] > 1 do
		table.remove(clicks, 1)
	end
	if #clicks >= E.mamaClickCap then
		return
	end
	table.insert(clicks, now)
	-- A legitimate third-person view must not grant attacks through a solid wall.
	local sight = RaycastParams.new()
	sight.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	sight.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, fight.model }
	sight.RespectCanCollide = true
	if workspace:Raycast(root.Position, orb.Position - root.Position, sight) then return false end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * ((orb.Position - origin).Magnitude + orb.Size.Magnitude), params)
	if not hit or hit.Instance ~= orb then return false end
	fight.damage[player] = (fight.damage[player] or 0) + 1
	player:SetAttribute("MamaDamage", fight.damage[player])
	fight.hp -= 1
	fight.flinchUntil = now + 0.15
	orb.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	task.delay(0.1, function()
		if not fight.over and orb.Parent and fight.activeOrb == orb then orb.Color = ORB_ON end
	end)
	afterDamage(fight)
	return true
end

local function buildMama(fight)
	local model = CreatureBuilder.buildGuardian("Cosmic", E.mamaScale)
	model.Name = "MamaDragon"
	for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Anchored = not model:GetAttribute("Rigged") or p == model.PrimaryPart
		end
	end
	CreatureBuilder.placeOn(model, CFrame.lookAt(START, FINISH))
	local boxCFrame, boxSize = model:GetBoundingBox()
	fight.orbs = {}
	for orbName, partName in ORBS do
		local host = model:FindFirstChild(partName)
		if host or model.PrimaryPart then
			local orb = Instance.new("Part")
			orb.Name = "WeakSpot" .. orbName
			orb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			orb.Size = Vector3.new(6, 6, 6)
			orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			orb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 90)
			orb.Anchored, orb.CanCollide, orb.CanTouch = true, false, false
			-- sit on the surface of the host part that faces out (front for head/chest, top for the tail)
			if host then
				local out = orbName == "Tail" and host.CFrame.UpVector or host.CFrame.LookVector
				orb.Position = host.Position + out * (orbName == "Tail" and host.Size.Y / 2 or host.Size.Z / 2)
			else
				orb.Position = (boxCFrame * CFrame.new(ORB_SPOTS[orbName] * boxSize)).Position
			end
			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness = orb.Color, 16, 3
			light.Parent = orb
			local click = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
			click.MaxActivationDistance = E.mamaClickRange
			click.Parent = orb
			click.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
				onHit(fight, player, orb)
			end)
			orb.Parent = model
			table.insert(fight.orbs, orb)
		end
	end
	model.Parent = workspace
	setActive(fight, fight.orbs[math.random(#fight.orbs)])
	return model
end

-- nearest plot (to her) whose owner has an incubating egg and isn't shielded
local function snatch(fight)
	local pos = fight.model:GetPivot().Position
	local best, bestDist
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local plot = PlotService.get(player)
		if plot and not MamaService.isShielded(player) and #HatchService.filledSlots(player) > 0 then
			local d = (plot.Floor.Position - pos).Magnitude
			if not bestDist or d < bestDist then
				best, bestDist = player, d
			end
		end
	end
	if not best then
		return
	end
	local slots = HatchService.filledSlots(best)
	local slot = slots[math.random(#slots)]
	local pad = PlotService.get(best).Incubators["Incubator" .. slot]
	local egg, progress = HatchService.takeEgg(best, slot)
	if not egg then
		return
	end
	local item = { owner = best, egg = egg, progress = progress }
	table.insert(fight.hoard, item)
	setAttr("MamaHoard", #fight.hoard)
	-- claw beam from her head to the incubator for a moment
	local head = fight.model:FindFirstChild("Head") or fight.model.PrimaryPart
	local a0, a1 = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
	a0.Parent, a1.Parent = head, pad
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Attachment0, beam.Attachment1 = a0, a1
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(190, 110, 255))
	beam.LightEmission, beam.Width0, beam.Width1, beam.FaceCamera = 1, 3, 1, true
	beam.Parent = head
	task.delay(0.7, function() beam:Destroy() a0:Destroy() a1:Destroy() end)
	-- the egg lands on her back (glowing hoard pile)
	local shown = CreatureBuilder.buildEgg(egg.biome, egg.mutation, egg.secret, egg.species)
	for _, p in shown:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery = true, false, false
		end
	end
	shown:ScaleTo(1.6)
	local n = #fight.hoard - 1
	local body = fight.model.PrimaryPart
	shown:PivotTo(body.CFrame * CFrame.new(((n % 3) - 1) * 3.5, body.Size.Y / 2 + 2 + (n // 3) * 3, 3 + (n // 3)))
	shown.Name = "HoardEgg"
	shown.Parent = fight.model
	item.shown = shown
	Notify:FireClient(best, "alarm", "Mama Dragon snatched an egg from your base! Hit her weak spots!")
end

local function finish(fight)
	local pos = fight.model:GetPivot().Position
	if fight.over == "defeated" then
		for _, item in fight.hoard do
			if item.owner.Parent then
				HatchService.give(item.owner, item.egg, item.progress)
			end
		end
		local top = topList(fight)
		local total = 0
		for _, row in top do
			total += row.dmg
		end
		for _, row in top do
			if row.dmg >= E.mamaRewardMinDamage then
				local best = row.player:GetAttribute("BestBiome") or 0
				local biome = Config.Biomes[math.max(1, best)].id
				local count = math.min(E.mamaRewardMax, 1 + math.floor(row.dmg / total / E.mamaRewardShareStep))
				for _ = 1, count do
					HatchService.give(row.player, { biome = biome, lucky = true })
				end
				Notify:FireClient(row.player, "toast", ("You got %d Lucky Egg%s!"):format(count, count > 1 and "s" or ""))
			end
		end
		Notify:FireAllClients("mama", { phase = "defeated", position = pos, eggs = #fight.hoard })
	else
		Notify:FireAllClients("mama", { phase = "escaped", eggs = #fight.hoard })
	end
	for _, loose in fight.loose do -- knocked-loose eggs nobody picked up go back to their owners
		if loose.model.Parent then
			loose.model:Destroy()
			if loose.egg.owner.Parent then
				HatchService.give(loose.egg.owner, loose.egg, loose.progress)
			end
		end
	end
	fight.model:Destroy()
	for _, name in { "MamaPhase", "MamaHP", "MamaMaxHP", "MamaEnds", "MamaTop", "MamaHoard" } do
		setAttr(name, nil)
	end
	active = nil
	return fight.over
end

-- Runs one full event and returns "defeated" or "escaped". opts (tests): warning, duration in seconds.
function MamaService.run(opts)
	if active then
		return nil
	end
	opts = opts or {}
	local fight = { damage = {}, clicks = {}, hoard = {}, loose = {}, flinchUntil = 0 }
	active = fight
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do player:SetAttribute("MamaDamage", 0) end
	local warning = opts.warning or E.mamaWarning
	setAttr("MamaPhase", "warning")
	setAttr("MamaEnds", os.time() + warning)
	Notify:FireAllClients("mama", { phase = "warning" })
	task.wait(warning)

	local duration = opts.duration or E.mamaDuration
	fight.hp = math.max(E.mamaMinHp, E.mamaHpPerPlayer * #Players:GetPlayers())
	fight.maxHp, fight.nextDrop = fight.hp, fight.hp * E.mamaDropEvery
	fight.model = buildMama(fight)
	setAttr("MamaMaxHP", fight.hp)
	setAttr("MamaHP", fight.hp)
	setAttr("MamaHoard", 0)
	setAttr("MamaTop", "")
	setAttr("MamaEnds", os.time() + duration)
	setAttr("MamaPhase", "active")
	Notify:FireAllClients("mama", { phase = "active" })

	local ground = fight.model:GetPivot().Y - START.Y
	local _, mamaSize = fight.model:GetBoundingBox()
	local joints = WalkCycle.bind(fight.model)
	local started = os.clock()
	local nextSnatch, nextStomp = started + E.mamaSnatchEvery, started + E.mamaStompEvery
	local nextBigStomp, nextSwitch = started + E.mamaBigStompEvery, started + E.mamaWeakSwitch
	while not fight.over do
		local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		local now = os.clock()
		local t = (now - started) / duration
		if t >= 1 then
			fight.over = "escaped"
			break
		end
		-- out to the Plaza in the first half, back to the road in the second
		local outbound = t < 0.5
		local a = outbound and t * 2 or (t - 0.5) * 2
		local from, to = outbound and START or FINISH, outbound and FINISH or START
		local pos = from:Lerp(to, a) + Vector3.new(0, ground, 0)
		-- heavy walk: one step per stomp, so each camera-shake stomp lands as a foot comes down
		local cf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + (to - from).Unit)
			* WalkCycle.offset((now - started) / E.mamaStompEvery, 1, mamaSize.Y, "heavy")
		if fight.flinchUntil > now then
			cf *= CFrame.Angles(math.rad(6), 0, 0)
		end
		fight.model:PivotTo(cf)
		WalkCycle.animateJoints(joints, (now - started) / E.mamaStompEvery, 1, now, "heavy", false)
		if now >= nextStomp then
			nextStomp += E.mamaStompEvery
			Notify:FireAllClients("stomp", pos)
		end
		if now >= nextSnatch then
			nextSnatch += E.mamaSnatchEvery
			task.spawn(snatch, fight)
		end
		if now >= nextBigStomp then
			nextBigStomp += E.mamaBigStompEvery
			task.spawn(bigStomp, fight)
		end
		if now >= nextSwitch then
			nextSwitch += E.mamaWeakSwitch
			switchOrb(fight)
		end
		if math.floor(now * 4) ~= math.floor((now - dt) * 4) then
			publishTop(fight)
		end
	end
	return finish(fight)
end

function MamaService.isActive(): boolean
	return active ~= nil
end

function MamaService.damage(player, amount: number) -- tests: deal damage as if clicked
	if active and active.hp then
		active.damage[player] = (active.damage[player] or 0) + amount
		active.hp -= amount
		afterDamage(active)
	end
end

-- Remote payloads never contain a damage amount; old clicks use the same handler.
function MamaService.hit(player, orb, origin, direction): boolean
	if not active or workspace:GetAttribute("MamaPhase") ~= "active" then return false end
	if typeof(orb) ~= "Instance" or typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
	return onHit(active, player, orb, origin, direction) == true
end

function MamaService.start()
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
	local hit = remotes:FindFirstChild("MamaHit") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	hit.Name = "MamaHit"
	hit.Parent = remotes
	hit.OnServerEvent:Connect(MamaService.hit)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(E.mamaInterval)
			while MamaService.weatherBusy() do -- never during a weather event
				task.wait(5)
			end
			MamaService.run()
		end
	end)
end

return MamaService

-- returns (goal position or nil, hint text or nil); nil, nil = tutorial finished
local function tutorialStep()
	if player:GetAttribute("Tips") == nil then
		return nil, nil
	end
	if done("done") then
		if finishedAt and os.clock() - finishedAt < 6 then
			return nil, "Tutorial complete! Open the Guide any time for help."
		end
		return nil, nil
	end
	if (player:GetAttribute("Rebirths") or 0) > 0 or (player:GetAttribute("BestBiome") or 0) >= 3 then
		mark("done") -- veterans from before the tutorial existed
		return nil, nil
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("CarryingEgg") then
		local plot = myPlot()
		return plot and plot.Spawn.Position, "Run it home before the guardian catches you!"
	end
	if not done("rode") then
		if (player:GetAttribute("CreatureCount") or 0) == 0 then
			if (player:GetAttribute("Incubating") or 0) > 0 then
				return nil, "Your egg is hatching. Watch the timer on your incubator!"
			end
			return nestPosition("Forest"), "Steal an egg from the Forest nest!"
		end
		if not player:GetAttribute("Riding") then
			return nil, "Ride your new creature! Open the Stable and press Ride."
		end
		mark("rode")
	end
	if not done("saddle") then
		if (player:GetAttribute("SaddleLevel") or 0) < 1 then
			if (player:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond") or 0) <= 0 then
				if (player:GetAttribute("Incubating") or 0) > 0 then
					return nil, "Let your next egg hatch. Keep that creature in the pen to earn cash!"
				end
				return nestPosition("Forest"), "Steal another egg! Your ride is for speed; pen creatures earn cash."
			end
			local price = Config.Costs.saddle(1)
			if (player:GetAttribute("Cash") or 0) < price then
				return nil, ("Your pen is earning! Save $%.0f for your first Saddle upgrade."):format(price)
			end
			return nil, "Open the Shop and get your first Saddle upgrade!"
		end
		mark("saddle")
	end
	if not done("lock") then
		-- a manual lock lasts longer than the free join lock, so that's how we spot the button press
		if (player:GetAttribute("LockLeft") or 0) <= Config.Plot.joinLock then
			local plot = myPlot()
			local button = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("LockButton")
			return button and button.Position, "Protect your eggs: press the red Lock button at your base."
		end
		mark("lock")
	end
	if not done("gear") then
		local owned = (player:GetAttribute("GearNet") or 0) + (player:GetAttribute("GearTrap") or 0) + (player:GetAttribute("GearSoda") or 0)
		if owned == 0 then
			return workspace.Plaza.GearShop:GetPivot().Position, "Visit the Gear Shop in the Plaza: nets, traps and speed soda."
		end
		mark("gear")
	end
	if (player:GetAttribute("BestBiome") or 0) < 2 then
		return nestPosition("Lake"), "Steal a Lake egg! Swim riders can hide from the Swan on the water patches."
	end
	mark("done")
	finishedAt = os.clock()
	return nil, "Tutorial complete! Open the Guide any time for help."
end

local function play(name: string, pitch: number?)
	local s = SFX:FindFirstChild(name)
	if s and s.SoundId ~= "" then
		if pitch then
			s = s:Clone()
			s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch
			s.Parent = SoundService
			s.Ended:Once(function() s:Destroy() end)
			s:Play()
		else
			SoundService:PlayLocalSound(s)
		end
	end
end

-- looping sounds (ambience, music, rain, heartbeat): a local copy we fade in and out
local loops = {}
local function loop(name: string, on: boolean, volume: number?)
	local template = SFX:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not template or template.SoundId == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local s = loops[name]
	if not s then
		s = template:Clone()
		s.Looped = true
		s.Volume = 0
		s.Parent = SoundService
		loops[name] = s
	end
	local target = on and (volume or template.Volume) or 0
	if on and not s.IsPlaying then
		s:Play()
	end
	local fade = TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(1.2), { Volume = target })
	fade.Completed:Once(function(state)
		if not on and state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and s.Volume < 0.01 then s:Stop() end
	end)
	fade:Play()
	return s
end

	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local cinematic = not cinematicBusy and root and (root.Position - top).Magnitude < 45 and not player:GetAttribute("CarryingEgg")
	local restore
	if cinematic then
		cinematicBusy = true
		restore = cam.CFrame
		cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		-- look from the player's side of the incubator, so the pen and its beams stay behind the egg
		local away = (root.Position - top) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		away = away.Magnitude > 0.1 and away.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
		local goal = CFrame.lookAt(top + away * 9 + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), top + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
		TweenService:Create(cam, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), { CFrame = goal }):Play()
	end
	local base = egg:GetPivot()
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < 1.5 do
		local t = os.clock() - t0
		egg:PivotTo(base * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(t * (14 + t * 10)) * math.rad(6 + t * 10)))
		RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
	end
	egg:Destroy()
	play("HatchCrack")
	play("RarityReveal")
	burst(top + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), rarity.color, 30 + rarity.index * 15, 10 + rarity.index * 4, 0.8 + rarity.index * 0.2)
	local creature = anchorAll(CreatureBuilder.build(result.species, result.rarity, result.mutation))
	local face = root and (root.Position - top) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
	face = face.Magnitude > 0.1 and face.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
	CreatureBuilder.placeOn(creature, CFrame.lookAt(top, top + face))
	local scale0 = creature:GetScale()
	creature.Parent = workspace
	local t1 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t1 < 0.45 do -- 0.2 -> 1.15 -> 1
		local a = (os.clock() - t1) / 0.45
		local s = a < 0.7 and 0.2 + (1.15 - 0.2) * (a / 0.7) or 1.15 - 0.15 * ((a - 0.7) / 0.3)
		creature:ScaleTo(scale0 * s)
		CreatureBuilder.placeOn(creature, CFrame.lookAt(top, top + face))
		RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
	end
	creature:ScaleTo(scale0)
	CreatureBuilder.placeOn(creature, CFrame.lookAt(top, top + face))
	task.wait(1.4)
	creature:Destroy()
	if cinematic then
		local back = TweenService:Create(cam, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), { CFrame = restore })
		back:Play()
		back.Completed:Wait()
		cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
		cinematicBusy = false
	end
end

-- mounts: animate every rider's MountWeld locally (steps follow the rider's ground speed)
-- pen creatures: gentle breathing for the pens near the camera
local mountState = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local penBase = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local ch = p.Character
		local weld = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Mount") and ch.Mount:FindFirstChild("MountWeld", true)
		local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if weld and root and weld:GetAttribute("BaseC0") and near(root.Position, 250) then
			local st = mountState[weld]
			if not st then
				st = { phase = 0, amount = 0, seed = math.random() * 10, joints = WalkCycle.bind(ch.Mount), turn = 0, look = root.CFrame.LookVector }
				mountState[weld] = st
			end
			local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local speed = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
			st.amount = math.clamp(st.amount + (speed > 1 and dt or -dt) * 5, 0, 1)
			st.phase += speed * dt / (weld:GetAttribute("Stride") or 3)
			local h = weld:GetAttribute("Height") or 4
			local humanoid = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local airborne = ch.Mount:GetAttribute("CanFly") and (p:GetAttribute("Flying") or humanoid and humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air)
			local gait = airborne and "fly" or weld:GetAttribute("Gait")
			local pose = airborne and WalkCycle.offset(now * 1.5, 1, h, "fly")
				or st.amount > .02 and WalkCycle.offset(st.phase, st.amount, h, gait) or WalkCycle.idle(now, h, st.seed)
			local turn = st.look:Cross(root.CFrame.LookVector).Y / math.max(dt, .001)
			st.look = root.CFrame.LookVector
			st.turn += (math.clamp(turn * .08, -.22, .22) - st.turn) * math.min(1, dt * 8)
			if airborne then pose *= CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -st.turn) end
			weld.C0 = weld:GetAttribute("BaseC0") * pose
			WalkCycle.animateJoints(st.joints, st.phase, st.amount, now, gait, airborne == true)
		end
	end
	for _, plot in workspace.HomeRow.Plots:GetChildren() do
		local pens = plot:FindFirstChild("PenModels")
		if pens and near(plot.Floor.Position, 180) then
			for _, m in pens:GetChildren() do
				local base = penBase[m]
				if not base then
					local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
					base = { cf = m:GetPivot(), h = m:GetAttribute("RestHeight") or size.Y, seed = math.random() * 10, joints = WalkCycle.bind(m) }
					penBase[m] = base
				end
				local floating = m:GetAttribute("CanFly") or m:GetAttribute("Gait") == "float"
				local pose = floating and CFrame.new(0, base.h * .2, 0) * WalkCycle.offset(now * .8 + base.seed, 1, base.h, "float")
					or WalkCycle.idle(now, base.h, base.seed)
				m:PivotTo(base.cf * pose)
				WalkCycle.animateJoints(base.joints, now * .5 + base.seed, 0, now + base.seed, m:GetAttribute("Gait") or "quad", m:GetAttribute("CanFly") == true)
			end
		end
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

if not remote then warn("[MamaInput] MamaHit remote missing") return end

local held, pointer, nextHit = nil, nil, 0
local function stop()
	held, pointer, nextHit = nil, nil, 0
end

local function aim(position)
	if workspace:GetAttribute("MamaPhase") ~= "active" then return end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not camera then return end
	for _, gui in player.PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(position.X, position.Y) do
		if gui.Active then return end -- a button/panel under the pointer owns this input
	end
	local ray = camera:ScreenPointToRay(position.X, position.Y)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	local result = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * (Config.Events.mamaClickRange + math.min(256, player.CameraMaxZoomDistance + 4)), params)
	local orb = result and result.Instance
	if orb and orb.Parent and orb.Parent.Name == "MamaDragon"
		and orb:GetAttribute("ActiveWeakSpot") == true
		and (root.Position - orb.Position).Magnitude <= Config.Events.mamaClickRange then
		return orb, ray
	end
end
